title.zh: Arbitrum joins Paxos-led stablecoin group Global Dollar to capture digital dollar growth
title.en: Arbitrum joins Paxos-led stablecoin group Global Dollar to capture digital dollar growth

current_state.zh: Arbitrum joined the Paxos-led Global Dollar Network, backing USDG and rolling it out across its DeFi ecosystem with Kraken providing on- and off-ramps, as it seeks a share of stablecoin reserve economics on a chain holding roughly $3.8 billion in stablecoins.
